Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
Do you have to discard a card or just "set cards aside" when in combat
with someone with a raptor?

Regardless, can you play thoughts betrayed?

Anyone know?

Robert

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robert Ekvall wrote:
>
> Do you have to discard a card or just "set cards aside" when in combat
> with someone with a raptor?

Discard. Revised Rulebook, 1.6.1.2: " If your hand size is changed
by a card in play, immediately discard down to or draw up to your
new hand size."

> Regardless, can you play thoughts betrayed?

Sure, if you still have it in your hand (i.e., you didn't have to
discard it) and you have dominate.
